content.text:
These files call or import `getServerSession` from `packages/features/auth/lib/getServerSession.ts`. That includes two imports that use the `@calcom/feature-auth` alias instead of `@calcom/features/auth`, which I counted because they have the same path suffix. I didn't confirm that alias resolves to the same package.

I left out three files that only mention the name:
- **`packages/features/auth/lib/getServerSession.ts`:** the definition itself.
- **`packages/features/auth/lib/getLocale.ts`:** only a comment.
- **`packages/features/auth/__mocks__/getServerSession.mocks.ts`:** only a comment. The test file imports it for its mock helpers.

Test files:
- `packages/features/auth/lib/getServerSession.test.ts` tests the function directly.
- `packages/app-store/stripepayment/pages/setup/__tests__/_getServerSideProps.test.ts` mocks it.
